# restic list locks, and restic --no-lock cat lock ID, while the job
# pc-k3j9x2m4q8w1z7v held an exclusive lock; then cat lock while restic on nas
# held a shared one. "time" is in UTC, as the holder's clock gave it.
$ restic list locks
--- stdout
957548b28ad835fddfcf4c6dc87f848776d0958785334399668f9647b3dce7a0
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ restic --no-lock cat lock 957548b28ad835fddfcf4c6dc87f848776d0958785334399668f9647b3dce7a0
--- stdout
{
  "time": "2026-11-10T13:18:55.32141967Z",
  "exclusive": true,
  "hostname": "pc-k3j9x2m4q8w1z7v",
  "username": "root",
  "pid": 22562
}
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ restic --no-lock cat lock 4e44bf94c6d920736271574acc78f155699cdb82f0dd85ef42db06259f0e2aa3
--- stdout
{

  "exclusive": false,

  "username": "root",
  "pid": 23062
